extras.price_arithmetic: USD 0.16/h is the cheapest card on the page read on 2026-10-24 (RTX A5000, Community Cloud); 10 h = USD 1.60 and 730 h = USD 116.80. The previous figure of USD 18.00 was the seed's 2 vCPU shape, which this record's own notes say is not the product

binding_note: billing is per second with no free allowance, so the metered rate is what binds; there is no quota to exhaust
